question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Spoken or done without any previous thought or preparation
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. Extempore.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given phrase describes an action performed without any prior preparation or thought.
 
• "**extempore**" means impromptu or without preparation.
 
• "**Extempore**" specifically refers to speaking or performing without preparation.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Extempore**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Inaugural:** This refers to the beginning or introduction of a system, policy, or period. 
 
• **Maiden:** This term is often used to describe something happening for the first time. For instance, a maiden voyage is the first journey made by a ship or aircraft. 
 
• **Initiative:** Initiative refers to the ability to assess and initiate things independently.
